verdict.rationale: A state agency that accepts online quarterly tax and wage filings through EAMS could plausibly offer a test environment for filers or payroll integrators, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test environment, or non-production mode. The probes found no API or OpenAPI spec, and the transactional portal sits behind an authenticated login.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
